summary: The money in energy innovation is chasing firm power for AI data centers. Behind the meter fuel cells and grid batteries are already earning real revenue at scale, while advanced nuclear and enhanced geothermal have crossed from paper to construction with their first power due 2026 to 2030. Fusion is still a science bet funded by tech giants and, oddly, a merger with Trump Media.

innovations.name: Behind the meter power for data centers
innovations.what: Data centers build their own power plants on site, using fuel cells, gas turbines, gas engines and batteries, instead of waiting years for a grid connection.
innovations.stage_why: It has moved from pilots to billion dollar quarters: Bloom Energy passed $1 billion of quarterly revenue in Q2 2026 and every major US hyperscaler has approved its systems.

evidence.cost: Bloom non GAAP gross margin about 34% in 2026 guidance. Grid interconnection waits of several years and turbine lead times of five to seven years are what make on site power worth a premium (Wood Mackenzie, 2026).
evidence.approvals: Air permits and gas hookups are the gating approvals. Regulators in PJM and ERCOT are writing new large load and co location rules (details vary by state).
evidence.money: Brookfield expanded its Bloom financing to $25 billion (June 2026). Oracle agreed up to 2.8 GW of Bloom fuel cells. GE Vernova has 116 GW of gas backlog plus reservations (Q2 2026).
evidence.revenue: Bloom Q2 2026 revenue $1.065 billion, up 166%; 2026 guidance raised to $3.9 to $4.2 billion with 25 GW of deployment visibility. Fluence booked about $850 million of data center business through July 2026.

spreads_to.use: Pipeline laterals and gas supply to data center campuses
Factories use the same on site power to avoid grid delays
Some utilities own and rent out on site generation (AEP with Bloom)

innovations.bottleneck: Gas turbines and large engines are sold out into 2028 to 2031, and controlled by GE Vernova, Siemens Energy and Mitsubishi Heavy. Fuel cells scale faster, but Bloom needs scandium and solid oxide stack capacity.

next_milestone.event: Bloom Q3 2026 results and new hyperscaler contracts

innovations.thesis_broken_if: Thesis breaks if grid interconnection speeds up enough that hyperscalers stop paying a premium for on site power, or if AI capex guidance is cut.

innovations.name: Grid scale battery storage
innovations.what: Large battery systems, mostly lithium iron phosphate, that soak up cheap power and release it at peak times. New chemistries (iron air, zinc) aim at 10 to 100 hour storage.
innovations.stage_why: Four hour lithium batteries are now a standard grid asset: the US installed a record 20.2 GWh in Q2 2026. Long duration chemistries are still at pilot to early adoption.

evidence.cost: Stationary storage battery packs fell to about $70/kWh in 2025, 45% below 2024 (BNEF). China 314 Ah storage cells rose from about $42/kWh (Oct 2025) to CNY 0.365/Wh (Apr 2026) as lithium rose, so the cost curve paused in 2026.
evidence.approvals: Storage keeps its federal investment tax credit under current law, with foreign entity rules limiting Chinese content (details unverified this session).
evidence.money: SEIA and Benchmark raised their 2030 US storage forecast 11.5% to 683 GWh. Form Energy raised a $750 million Series G and says its backlog grew from about 20 GWh to 80 GWh in 2026. A hyperscaler gave Fluence about $550 million of orders through July 2026.
evidence.revenue: US utility scale storage capacity rose from 88 GWh to 165 GWh in 18 months. Fluence backlog is about $6.4 billion. Tesla deployed 46.7 GWh of storage in 2025. Eos grew Q2 2026 revenue 351% to $68.8 million and guides $300 to $350 million for 2026.

spreads_to.use: On site batteries smooth GPU power swings and bridge until grid hookups arrive
Replace gas peaker plants and firm up solar
Off grid microgrids at remote sites

innovations.bottleneck: Battery cells and their materials, about 90% controlled by Chinese makers (CATL, BYD, EVE). US rules penalizing Chinese content make non Chinese cell supply (LG Energy Solution, Samsung SDI, Tesla) the scarce input. Transformers and grid interconnection queues are the second bottleneck.

next_milestone.event: SEIA and Benchmark Q4 2026 US storage report; Form Energy Georgia Power 15 MW, 1,500 MWh iron air system start

innovations.thesis_broken_if: Thesis breaks if quarterly US installs fall year over year for two quarters, or if foreign content rules choke cell supply and push project prices up enough to stall utility orders.

innovations.name: Small modular and advanced nuclear
innovations.what: Smaller reactors built in factories, plus new designs cooled by sodium, gas or molten salt. The goal is firm, carbon free power that can sit next to a data center or replace a coal plant.
innovations.stage_why: Test reactors are now reaching criticality and the first commercial units have construction permits, but no SMR sells power to the grid yet in North America. First commercial power is 2028 to 2030.

evidence.cost: Ontario's four unit BWRX-300 project at Darlington was budgeted at about C$20.9 billion in May 2025, or roughly C$7.7 billion for the first unit including shared infrastructure (unverified this session). TerraPower's Kemmerer plant is about $4 billion with DOE cost share up to $2 billion.
evidence.approvals: NRC issued TerraPower's Natrium construction permit in March 2026. OPG filed its operating license application for the first Darlington BWRX-300 in March 2026. Under the DOE Reactor Pilot Program, Antares and Valar reached criticality in June 2026, Aalo on July 4, 2026, and Oklo's Groves isotope test reactor in August 2026 (fifth DOE authorized reactor).
evidence.money: Oklo held $3.0 billion of cash and securities at the end of Q2 2026. DOE gave Centrus a $900 million HALEU task order. The US government struck an $80 billion partnership with Westinghouse owners Brookfield and Cameco (October 2025). Hyperscalers back developers: Amazon with X-energy, Google with Kairos (both private).
evidence.revenue: Essentially none from SMR power sales yet. Revenue sits with fuel and component suppliers (Cameco, Centrus, BWXT, Curtiss-Wright). NuScale's partner ENTRA1 still had no definitive TVA power contract as of August 2026.

spreads_to.use: Long term contracts for 24/7 clean power on or near campus
Process heat and steam, for example X-energy with Dow at Seadrift, Texas
Microreactors for remote bases and isotopes for medicine and sensors
Medical isotope production from test reactors, Oklo's first critical reactor is an isotope unit

innovations.bottleneck: HALEU fuel (high assay low enriched uranium). Centrus is the only US producer and Russia was the main foreign source. Second chokepoint is nuclear grade large forgings and NRC licensing time.

next_milestone.event: Oklo Aurora INL construction progress and a definitive ENTRA1 and TVA power contract for NuScale
next_milestone.timing: Aurora targeted for 2028 startup; TVA deal timing not set

innovations.thesis_broken_if: Thesis breaks if first of a kind units blow through budgets the way Vogtle did, or if HALEU supply slips past 2030 with no Western replacement.

innovations.name: Enhanced geothermal
innovations.what: Uses oil and gas drilling and fracking methods to make man made reservoirs in hot rock, then circulates water to make steam for power. It gives firm, carbon free power almost anywhere with hot rock.
innovations.stage_why: The first large plant (Fervo Cape Station, Utah) has 500 MW under construction and targets first power in Q4 2026. Nothing at commercial scale runs yet, but contracts and a large IPO show real money.

evidence.cost: Power contracts are pricing at about $100 to $130/MWh (Fervo, 2026). Fervo targets installed cost of about $3,000/kW through faster drilling.
evidence.approvals: Cape Station is on federal land in Utah under BLM permits; Congress and the Interior Department have fast tracked geothermal permitting since 2025 (details unverified this session).
evidence.money: Fervo raised about $1.9 billion in an upsized Nasdaq IPO priced at $27, above range, in 2026 (one source cites $2.2 billion including other proceeds). Google signed a 3 GW geothermal framework agreement with Fervo.
evidence.revenue: Fervo has 658 MW of signed power purchase agreements. Ormat runs conventional geothermal at scale and is profitable. No enhanced geothermal plant is selling power yet.

spreads_to.use: 24/7 clean power contracts, Google and Meta are early buyers
Drilling rigs, frac crews and well tools find a second market
Firm clean capacity to back up wind and solar

innovations.bottleneck: Drilling rigs and frac crews skilled with hot, hard rock, plus high temperature downhole tools. Supply sits with Halliburton, SLB, Baker Hughes, Nabors and Helmerich and Payne. Transmission access in Nevada and Utah is the second limit.

next_milestone.event: First power from Cape Station GeoBlock 1

innovations.thesis_broken_if: Thesis breaks if Cape Station misses first power badly or wells lose heat and flow faster than modeled, which would raise the cost per MWh.

innovations.name: Fusion power
innovations.what: Fusing light atoms, as the sun does, to release heat for power plants. Private companies use strong magnets or pulsed systems to try to get more energy out than they put in.
innovations.stage_why: No machine has produced net electricity. The key test, Commonwealth Fusion's SPARC, aims for first plasma and energy gain in 2027. Power plant dates (Helion 2028, CFS early 2030s) are promises, not proven.

evidence.approvals: The NRC decided in 2023 to regulate fusion under its byproduct materials rules, a lighter path than fission (unverified this session).
evidence.money: TAE Technologies agreed an all stock merger with Trump Media (DJT) valuing it above $6 billion, expected to close mid 2026 (closing unverified this session). Google and Eni signed power offtake deals with CFS's planned ARC plant in Virginia (2025, unverified this session). TAE had raised more than $1.2 billion before the merger.
evidence.revenue: No power revenue. Helion has a contract to supply Microsoft from its 50 MW Orion plant in Malaga, Washington, targeted for 2028.

spreads_to.use: Long dated power purchase agreements, Microsoft with Helion, Google with CFS
High temperature superconducting tape also serves power cables, MRI and motors
Lasers and pulsed power research overlap with fusion work

innovations.bottleneck: High temperature superconducting tape (REBCO) for magnets, made by a handful of firms such as Faraday Factory Japan, Fujikura, SuperOx and Furukawa's SuperPower. Tritium fuel supply is the second hard limit.
innovations.thesis_broken_if: Thesis breaks if SPARC fails to reach energy gain by 2028 or Helion misses its 2028 Microsoft date with no working prototype.
